before.en: Good morning. We'll start loading general cargo at 9 AM today. Have you prepared the loading plan and tools?
before.cn: 早上好。今日上午 9 点开始装卸杂货，装卸方案和工具准备好了吗？

after.en: Good morning. We'll start loading general cargo at 9 AM today. Have you prepared the loading plan and tools?
after.cn: 早上好。我们今天上午9点开始装载杂货。装货计划和工具准备好了吗？

changes.reason: loading仅指装货，译为装卸扩大了动作范围。

before.en: Captain, the latest forecast shows that there will be moderate rain and force 5-6 winds in the afternoon, with swells of 2-3 meters.
before.cn: 船长，最新预报显示今日下午有中雨，风力 5-6 级，浪高 2-3 米。

after.en: Captain, the latest forecast shows that there will be moderate rain and force 5-6 winds in the afternoon, with swells of 2-3 meters.
after.cn: 船长，最新预报显示下午有中雨，风力5—6级，涌浪高2—3米。

changes.reason: swells是涌浪；只译浪高丢失风浪/涌浪的区别。

before.en: Roger. I'll rig the pilot ladder on our starboard side, one meter above the waterline. Over.
before.cn: 收到。我把引航员的梯子放在右舷，在水线之上一米。结束。

after.en: Roger. I'll rig the pilot ladder on our starboard side, one meter above the waterline. Over.
after.cn: 收到。我会在右舷装设引航梯，距水面一米。完毕，请回答。

changes.reason: Over被译成结束，改变了是否等待答复的通信状态；rig应为装设/架设引航梯。

before.en: OK. Bring the engines to full ahead and change our course to 002, please.
before.cn: 好的。请把主机开到前进三，航向002。

after.en: OK. Bring the engines to full ahead and change our course to 002, please.
after.cn: 好的。请将主机调至全速前进，并将航向转至002度。

changes.reason: full ahead宜使用全速前进，避免把未说明船舶的车钟编号当作通用标准。

before.en: Captain, there's an escort boat about 500 meters ahead.
before.cn: 船长，前方500米处有一艘护卫舰。

after.en: Captain, there's an escort boat about 500 meters ahead.
after.cn: 船长，前方约500米处有一艘护航艇。

changes.reason: escort boat被具体化为护卫舰，原文没有给出军舰性质。

before.en: carry this the same way you carry that.
before.cn: 你拿那个和这个一样的方式。

after.en: carry this the same way you carry that.
after.cn: 搬这个时，也用搬那个的方法。

changes.reason: 中文语序混乱，比较关系不清。

before.en: Now, let's do the breast wires.
before.cn: 现在，我们来松横缆。

after.en: Now, let's do the breast wires.
after.cn: 现在我们来处理横向钢丝缆。

changes.reason: 英文只说接着处理横向钢丝缆，中文擅自加入松缆动作。

before.en: We have to shift the wires from the port side with the messenger rope, since she'll berth on her starboard side. Mike,
before.cn: 我们得把缆绳从左舷移开，因为她会在右舷停泊。麦克，

after.en: We have to shift the wires from the port side with the messenger rope, since she'll berth on her starboard side. Mike,
after.cn: 由于本船要右舷靠泊，我们得用引缆把钢丝缆从左舷移过去。

changes.reason: 漏掉了用引缆移缆的方法信息，末尾人名也是下一句的开头。

before.en: It passed clearly, sir.
before.cn: 它清楚地过去了，先生。

after.en: It passed clearly, sir.
after.cn: 卸扣已顺利通过，先生。

changes.reason: clearly按清楚地直译不合上下文；此处是在报告卸扣已通过导缆装置。

before.en: I'd like to ask you about the navigation course that you made.
before.cn: 我想问一下你的航海课程。

after.en: I'd like to ask you about the navigation course that you made.
after.cn: 我想问一下你拟定的计划航线。

changes.reason: 航行计划语境中的course被译成课程。

before.en: I think I wrote that down in the pilot chart.
before.cn: 我记得我写在引航卡里了。

after.en: I think I wrote that down in the pilot chart.
after.cn: 我记得在航路设计图上记下了这一点。

changes.reason: pilot chart被混同为pilot card；当前讨论季节性海流，应指航路设计/海洋气候资料图。

before.en: When you enter the waypoint, then it gives you the ETA automatically.
before.cn: 当你进入航路点，然后它会自动给出预计到达时间。

after.en: When you enter the waypoint, then it gives you the ETA automatically.
after.cn: 输入航路点后，程序就会自动算出预计到达时间。

changes.reason: 软件操作中的enter是输入，不是船舶进入航路点。

before.en: May I take over the watch?
before.cn: 我可以代替你吗？

after.en: May I take over the watch?
after.cn: 我可以接班了吗？

changes.reason: take over the watch漏掉了接班这一核心动作。

before.en: Yes, I have. I'll take over, sir. Thank you.
before.cn: 是的，我有。我来接替，先生，谢谢。

after.en: Yes, I have. I'll take over, sir. Thank you.
after.cn: 是的，我已经读过了。我现在接班，谢谢。

changes.reason: Yes, I have承接的是已读船长夜航命令，不能译成我有。

before.en: He's also in charge of maintaining the fuel oil, including purifier maintenance, keeping the logbook and filing the noon report.
before.cn: 他还负责维护燃油，包括净化器维护，记录工作日志，归档中午工作报告。

after.en: He's also in charge of maintaining the fuel oil, including purifier maintenance, keeping the logbook and filing the noon report.
after.cn: 他还负责燃油系统管理，包括分油机维护、填写日志和提交午报。

changes.reason: 燃油系统语境的purifier不宜泛译净化器；noon report宜按船舶午报处理。

before.en: The engine crew is scheduled to chip the pipeline on the Upper Deck during the next voyage, so we should demonstrate how to use and care for chipping goggles.
before.cn: 在下航次中，轮机部计划保养主甲板上的管道，所以我们应该示范如何使用和保养除锈护目镜。

after.en: The engine crew is scheduled to chip the pipeline on the Upper Deck during the next voyage, so we should demonstrate how to use and care for chipping goggles.
after.cn: 下航次轮机部计划对上甲板管路敲锈，因此应示范除锈护目镜的使用和保养。

changes.reason: 漏掉chipping具体的敲锈/除锈动作；Upper Deck与主甲板的对应也需统一。

before.en: The power supply will be OK, although the GM distance will be too short.
before.cn: 电源供电正常，虽然GM距离会太小。

after.en: The power supply will be OK, although the GM distance will be too short.
after.cn: 供电没有问题，不过初稳性高度GM可能偏小。

changes.reason: GM距离是生硬直译，GM通常应使用初稳性高度等专业名称。

before.en: Oh, no! My clothes in the washing machine must be finished by now.
before.cn: 哦，不！我在洗衣机里的衣服现在必须洗完了。

after.en: Oh, no! My clothes in the washing machine must be finished by now.
after.cn: 哦，糟了！洗衣机里的衣服这会儿想必已经洗好了。

changes.reason: must在这里是推测语气，不是必须完成的要求。

before.en: Wiper, look out!
before.cn: 二机，小心！

after.en: Wiper, look out!
after.cn: 机舱清洁员，小心！

changes.reason: Wiper是机舱清洁工/清洁员，不应译成二机。

before.en: This is only a one-ton crane, and that load's near the limit.
before.cn: 这只是一台一吨重的起重机，负荷已经接近极限了。

after.en: This is only a one-ton crane, and that load's near the limit.
after.cn: 这台起重机的额定起重量只有一吨，这一吊的重量已经接近极限了。

changes.reason: one-ton crane在吊运限载语境说的是起重能力，不是起重机自身重量。

before.en: Only put ten cylinders in the next sling.
before.cn: 下一个吊索只放了十个钢瓶。

after.en: Only put ten cylinders in the next sling.
after.cn: 下一吊只装十只钢瓶。

changes.reason: 命令被译成过去事实；sling在上下文指一吊货物/吊运批次。

before.en: Two ship chandlers have boarded and they say they have eight slings for us.
before.cn: 两个船上的人已经上船了，他们说有8个吊索给我们。

after.en: Two ship chandlers have boarded and they say they have eight slings for us.
after.cn: 两名船舶供应商人员已登船，他们说有八吊物料要交给我们。

changes.reason: ship chandlers身份丢失；上下文eight slings指要吊运的物料批次，而不宜直接理解成八根吊索。

before.en: We'll start bringing them aboard, sir.
before.cn: 我们会带他们上船的，长官。

after.en: We'll start bringing them aboard, sir.
after.cn: 我们这就开始把物料吊上船。

changes.reason: them承接物料而非已经上船的供应商人员，原译主客体错误。

before.en: Start loading.
before.cn: 开始加载。

after.en: Start loading.
after.cn: 开始装运物料。

changes.reason: loading按软件语境译成加载。

before.en: Pump man, swing it to this side and put it down here.
before.cn: 二机，把它摆到这边，放在这里。

after.en: Pump man, swing it to this side and put it down here.
after.cn: 泵匠，把这一吊回转到这边，在这里放下。

changes.reason: Pump man是泵匠/泵工，不应与Wiper一起都译成二机。

before.en: Captain, we have one more sling to pick up, and we've just started to lift it now.
before.cn: 船长，我们还有一根吊索要拿，我们现在才开始把它抬起来。

after.en: Captain, we have one more sling to pick up, and we've just started to lift it now.
after.cn: 船长，还剩一吊物料要吊上船，我们现在刚开始起吊。

changes.reason: 一吊物料被误当成一根吊索，改变了吊运对象。

before.en: Yes, please do.
before.cn: 是的，请说。

after.en: Yes, please do.
after.cn: 是的，请按这个方案执行。

changes.reason: please do承接前面的按计划操作，不能一律译成请说。

before.en: The other hatches are evenly loaded, but No.2 Hatch is being over loaded on the starboard side.
before.cn: 其他舱口都均匀装载，但是右舷2号舱超载了。

after.en: The other hatches are evenly loaded, but No.2 Hatch is being over loaded on the starboard side.
after.cn: 其他货舱装载均匀，但2号舱右舷侧装得过多。

changes.reason: 右舷2号舱容易误解为舱的位置；英文是2号舱内部右舷侧装货过多。

before.en: Can you tighten the lashing bars in Bay No. 3?
before.cn: 你能把3号舱的绑扎杆拧紧吗？

after.en: Can you tighten the lashing bars in Bay No. 3?
after.cn: 请把03贝位的绑扎杆紧固一下，好吗？

changes.reason: 集装箱语境的Bay是贝位，不能改成货舱编号。

before.en: So when you finish this one, follow me.
before.cn: 所以看完这个，跟我来。

after.en: So when you finish this one, follow me.
after.cn: 做完手头这项活后，跟我来。

changes.reason: finish this one被译成看完这个；上下文是完成手头工作。

before.en: So we can't always enjoy sports.
before.cn: 所以我们经常享受运动。

after.en: So we can't always enjoy sports.
after.cn: 所以我们并不总能参加体育活动。

changes.reason: 否定完全丢失，译文把不能总是参加运动反向变成经常享受运动。

before.en: As far as children are concerned,
before.cn: 就小孩子关注的而言，

after.en: As far as children are concerned,
after.cn: 就孩子们而言，

changes.reason: as far as ... are concerned在此是就……而言，不是孩子关注的内容。

before.en: That's a good idea since we can't watch TV in here.
before.cn: 在不能看电视后，这是个好主意。

after.en: That's a good idea since we can't watch TV in here.
after.cn: 这里看不了电视，所以看录像是个好主意。

changes.reason: since表示原因，不是时间先后。

before.en: however, is their concentration.
before.cn: 然而，是他们的混合。

after.en: however, is their concentration.
after.cn: 不过，更重要的是它们的浓度。

changes.reason: concentration是浓度，不只是混合，且该条需要与前句连读。

before.en: placed a watch on deck and prepared their breathing apparatus,
before.cn: 在甲板上安排瞭望并准备好呼吸器，

after.en: placed a watch on deck and prepared their breathing apparatus,
after.cn: 在外部安排监护人员，并备妥呼吸器，

changes.reason: 封闭处所语境的placed a watch是安排人员监护/值守，不只是航行瞭望。

before.en: I was thinking of doing that myself.
before.cn: 我本来想自己去的。

after.en: I was thinking of doing that myself.
after.cn: 我自己也正打算打扫一下。

changes.reason: doing that回指清理房间，原译自己去的指代丢失。

before.en: Engine room, this is bridge. Finished with engine.
before.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。完车。

after.en: Engine room, this is bridge. Finished with engine.
after.cn: 机舱，这里是驾驶台。完车。

changes.reason: 驾驶台与机舱的收发身份译反。

before.en: Yes, I have. The synopsis shows a deep depression centered at 45°N 160°E, moving eastward at 25 knots.
before.cn: 收到了。天气形势显示一个加深的低压中心位于北纬45度东经160度，向东移动，速度25节。

after.en: Yes, I have. The synopsis shows a deep depression centered at 45°N 160°E, moving eastward at 25 knots.
after.cn: 收到了。天气形势显示一个深低压中心位于北纬45度、东经160度，正以25节向东移动。

changes.reason: deep depression表示深低压，不能仅凭deep译成正在加深的低压。

before.en: Wind is from 230 degrees at 22 knots, gusting 28. Cloud cover is 7 oktas, mainly Cumulus and Stratocumulus.
before.cn: 风向230度，风速22节，阵风28节。云量7八分，主要是积云和层积云。

after.en: Wind is from 230 degrees at 22 knots, gusting 28. Cloud cover is 7 oktas, mainly Cumulus and Stratocumulus.
after.cn: 风从230度方向吹来，风速22节，阵风28节。云量7/8，主要为积云和层积云。

changes.reason: 云量7 oktas宜清楚表达为八分量中的七份。

before.en: C1: Thank you. The captain is waiting for your arrival in his room. Please follow me. I'll also arrange a crew member to accompany you during the inspection.
before.cn: C1: 谢谢。船长正在房间等候，请随我来。我会安排一名船员全程陪同您检查。

after.en: Thank you. The captain is waiting for your arrival in his room. Please follow me. I'll also arrange a crew member to accompany you during the inspection.
after.cn: 谢谢。船长正在房间等候，请随我来。我会安排一名船员全程陪同您检查。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Appreciate it. How long will the inspection take roughly? I have another ship to check this afternoon.
before.cn: C2: 感谢配合。检查大概需要多久？我下午还要检查另一艘船。

after.en: Thank you. Is there anything that may affect the inspection? I have another vessel to inspect this afternoon.
after.cn: 谢谢。有什么情况可能影响检查进度吗？我下午还要检查另一艘船。

before.en: C1: It depends on the situation, usually about one to two hours. We've prepared all relevant documents for you in advance.
before.cn: C1: 视情况而定，通常 1-2 小时。我们已提前备好所有相关文件。

after.en: It depends on the situation, usually about one to two hours. We've prepared all relevant documents for you in advance.
after.cn: 视情况而定，通常 1-2 小时。我们已提前备好所有相关文件。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: That's very thoughtful.
before.cn: C2: 考虑得很周到。

after.en: That's very thoughtful.
after.cn: 考虑得很周到。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Enjoy your stay. If you need any help during your visit, please feel free to tell me.
before.cn: C1: 祝您在船一切顺利。访问期间如有任何需求，随时告知我。

after.en: Enjoy your stay. If you need any help during your visit, please feel free to tell me.
after.cn: 祝您在船一切顺利。访问期间如有任何需求，随时告知我。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C1: All crew members, this is the captain speaking. Evacuate the affected area immediately. Follow the emergency procedures and head to the lifeboats with your lifejackets.
before.cn: C1: 全体船员，我是船长。立即撤离受影响区域，遵循应急程序，穿戴救生衣前往救生艇处。

after.en: All crew members, this is the captain speaking. Evacuate the affected area immediately. Follow the emergency procedures and head to the lifeboats with your lifejackets.
after.cn: 全体船员，我是船长。立即撤离受影响区域，遵循应急程序，穿戴救生衣前往救生艇处。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Captain, the fire fighting team has arrived at the scene and started spraying foam. Lifeboats are being prepared. Shall we start lowering them?
before.cn: C2: 船长，消防小组已抵达现场，开始喷射泡沫灭火。救生艇正在准备，是否开始下放？

after.en: Captain, the fire fighting team has arrived at the scene and started spraying foam. Lifeboats are being prepared. Shall we start lowering them?
after.cn: 船长，消防小组已抵达现场，开始喷射泡沫灭火。救生艇正在准备，是否开始下放？
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Yes, start lowering the lifeboats one by one. Ensure everyone wears their lifejackets correctly. Make sure we account for all crew members before leaving the ship.
before.cn: C1: 是的，依次下放救生艇。确保所有人正确穿戴救生衣，离船前务必清点所有船员人数。

after.en: Yes, start lowering the lifeboats one by one. Ensure everyone wears their lifejackets correctly. Make sure we account for all crew members before leaving the ship.
after.cn: 是的，依次下放救生艇。确保所有人正确穿戴救生衣，离船前务必清点所有船员人数。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Understood, Captain. All crew members are accounted for and boarding the lifeboats now. No one is left behind.
before.cn: C2: 明白，船长。所有船员已清点完毕，正在登上救生艇，无人员遗漏。

after.en: Understood, Captain. All crew members are accounted for and boarding the lifeboats now. No one is left behind.
after.cn: 明白，船长。所有船员已清点完毕，正在登上救生艇，无人员遗漏。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Ok. Inform the coast guard about our situation and request immediate assistance. Report the fire location and ship details clearly.
before.cn: C1: 好的。向海岸警卫队通报情况，请求紧急援助，清晰说明失火位置和船舶信息。

after.en: Ok. Inform the coast guard about our situation and request immediate assistance. Report the fire location and ship details clearly.
after.cn: 好的。向海岸警卫队通报情况，请求紧急援助，清晰说明失火位置和船舶信息。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Coast guard has been informed, Captain. They're sending a rescue team and fire boats our way, expected to arrive in 20 minutes.
before.cn: C2: 船长，已通知海岸警卫队，他们正派遣救援队和消防船赶来，预计 20 分钟抵达。

after.en: Coast guard has been informed, Captain. They're sending a rescue team and fire boats our way, expected to arrive in 20 minutes.
after.cn: 船长，已通知海岸警卫队，他们正派遣救援队和消防船赶来，预计 20 分钟抵达。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Stay calm, everyone. We'll get through this together. Keep communication open and follow all instructions.
before.cn: C1: 大家保持冷静，我们会共渡难关。保持通讯畅通，严格遵守指令。

after.en: Stay calm, everyone. We'll get through this together. Keep communication open and follow all instructions.
after.cn: 大家保持冷静，我们会共渡难关。保持通讯畅通，严格遵守指令。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: The anchor chain's severely worn, some links are deformed, needs immediate replacing. Also, the starboard hull has obvious rust spots.
before.cn: 锚链严重磨损，部分链节变形，需立即更换；右舷船体有明显锈迹。

after.en: The anchor chain is severely worn and some links are deformed. It needs immediate replacement. There are also rust patches on the starboard side of the hull.
after.cn: 锚链严重磨损，部分链节变形，需要立即更换。右舷船体也有锈斑。

before.en: C1: Okay, note down the specifications of the new anchor chain and report to the chief officer. And check the bilge pumps for slowness or abnormal noise.
before.cn: C1: 好的，记录新锚链的规格并上报大副。另外检查舱底泵是否运转缓慢或有异常噪音。

after.en: Okay, note down the specifications of the new anchor chain and report to the chief officer. And check the bilge pumps for slowness or abnormal noise.
after.cn: 好的，记录新锚链的规格并上报大副。另外检查舱底泵是否运转缓慢或有异常噪音。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Will do. The bilge pumps worked slowly yesterday, I'll check the pipeline for blockages. Shall we paint the rusty hull after cleaning the rust?
before.cn: C2: 收到。昨天舱底泵运转缓慢，我会检查管路是否堵塞。除锈后是否给生锈船体刷漆？

after.en: The bilge pumps operated slowly yesterday. I will check the pipelines for blockages. Shall we paint the hull after removing the rust?
after.cn: 昨天舱底泵运转缓慢。我会检查管路是否堵塞。船体除锈后是否刷漆？

before.en: C1: Yes, arrange the anti-rust paint, brushes and other supplies. Finish the rust removal and painting work this week before the heavy rain comes.
before.cn: C1: 是的，备好防锈漆、刷子等物料，本周大雨来临前完成除锈刷漆工作。

after.en: Yes, arrange the anti-rust paint, brushes and other supplies. Finish the rust removal and painting work this week before the heavy rain comes.
after.cn: 是的，备好防锈漆、刷子等物料，本周大雨来临前完成除锈刷漆工作。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Understood. I'll organize the crew to divide the work and finish promptly. We'll also clean the deck and remove all sundries by the way.
before.cn: C2: 明白。我会组织船员分工协作，尽快完工，顺便清理甲板、清除杂物。

after.en: Understood. I'll organize the crew to divide the work and finish promptly. We'll also clean the deck and remove all sundries by the way.
after.cn: 明白。我会组织船员分工协作，尽快完工，顺便清理甲板、清除杂物。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Good. Pay attention to safety when working at height. Wear safety harnesses and set up warning signs around the working area.
before.cn: C1: 很好。高空作业注意安全，系好安全带，作业区域周围设置警示标识。

after.en: Good. Pay attention to safety when working at height. Wear safety harnesses and set up warning signs around the working area.
after.cn: 很好。高空作业注意安全，系好安全带，作业区域周围设置警示标识。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: Hey, ANDY, fancy a game of ping-pong later to relax? We've been busy with work these days, need to unwind.
before.cn: 嗨，ANDY，待会儿要不要打乒乓球放松下？这几天工作太忙，得解压一下。

after.en: Andy, would you like to play table tennis later? We have been busy and need to relax.
after.cn: Andy，待会儿要不要打乒乓球？最近工作忙，需要放松一下。

before.en: C1: How about after lunch, around 1 o'clock? The playroom should be empty then, no one will disturb us.
before.cn: C1: 午饭后 1 点左右怎么样？那时候娱乐室没人，不会被打扰。

after.en: How about after lunch, around 1 o'clock? The playroom should be empty then, no one will disturb us.
after.cn: 午饭后 1 点左右怎么样？那时候娱乐室没人，不会被打扰。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Good idea. I'll bring the rackets; I've got a couple of new ones we can try out. They're very light and comfortable to hold.
before.cn: C2: 好主意。我带球拍，我有两个新球拍，很轻、握着舒服，咱们试试。

after.en: Good idea. I'll bring the rackets; I've got a couple of new ones we can try out. They're very light and comfortable to hold.
after.cn: 好主意。我带球拍，我有两个新球拍，很轻、握着舒服，咱们试试。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Awesome, I'll grab some new balls. How about we play best of three sets to make it interesting? Loser has to do the cleaning of the playroom tomorrow.
before.cn: C1: 太棒了，我去拿新球。咱们打三局两胜制，增加点趣味，输的人明天打扫娱乐室怎么样？

after.en: Awesome, I'll grab some new balls. How about we play best of three sets to make it interesting? Loser has to do the cleaning of the playroom tomorrow.
after.cn: 太棒了，我去拿新球。咱们打三局两胜制，增加点趣味，输的人明天打扫娱乐室怎么样？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Sounds perfect. How about we put a little bet on it? Loser buys the winner a cold drink from the fridge.
before.cn: C2: 没问题。咱们再赌一把？输的人给赢的人买杯冰箱里的冷饮。

after.en: Sounds perfect. How about we put a little bet on it? Loser buys the winner a cold drink from the fridge.
after.cn: 没问题。咱们再赌一把？输的人给赢的人买杯冰箱里的冷饮。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Hmm, how about this – winner gets an extra scoop of ice cream at dinner and a can of soda.
before.cn: C1: 不如这样，赢的人晚餐多一勺冰淇淋，再加一罐汽水。

after.en: Hmm, how about this – winner gets an extra scoop of ice cream at dinner and a can of soda.
after.cn: 不如这样，赢的人晚餐多一勺冰淇淋，再加一罐汽水。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Deal! We'll meet at 1 PM, sharp? Don't be late.
before.cn: C2: 一言为定！下午 1 点整见面，别迟到。

after.en: Deal! We'll meet at 1 PM, sharp? Don't be late.
after.cn: 一言为定！下午 1 点整见面，别迟到。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Absolutely, no later. I'll finish my lunch early and wait for you there. See you then!
before.cn: C1: 肯定准时到，我早点吃完午饭去等你。到时候见！

after.en: Certainly. I will be on time. I will finish lunch early and wait for you there.
after.cn: 当然。我会准时到，早点吃完午饭在那里等你。

before.en: C2: See you, can't wait! Should be a good match. Let's have fun.
before.cn: C2: 到时候见，太期待了！肯定很精彩，好好玩一场。

after.en: See you, can't wait! Should be a good match. Let's have fun.
after.cn: 到时候见，太期待了！肯定很精彩，好好玩一场。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: Sure, it's not far from here. Go straight ahead for about 500 meters and turn left at the second crossing. You'll see a bus stop there.
before.cn: 当然，不远。直走约 500 米，第二个十字路口左转，就能看到公交站。

after.en: Go straight ahead for about 500 metres and turn left at the second junction. The subway station is a five-minute walk from that junction.
after.cn: 向前直走约500米，在第二个路口左转。从那个路口步行五分钟就到地铁站。

before.en: C1: Is it far from here after turning left? And which subway line should I take?
before.cn: C1: 左转后还远吗？要坐几号线地铁？

after.en: Is it far from here after turning left? And which subway line should I take?
after.cn: 左转后还远吗？要坐几号线地铁？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: No, it's just a five-minute walk from the crossing. Take Line 3, it goes directly to the city center. The station name is Central Station.
before.cn: C2: 不远，从路口步行 5 分钟就到。坐 3 号线，直达市中心，站名是中央站。

after.en: No, it's just a five-minute walk from the crossing. Take Line 3, it goes directly to the city center. The station name is Central Station.
after.cn: 不远，从路口步行 5 分钟就到。坐 3 号线，直达市中心，站名是中央站。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: That's convenient. Are there any shopping malls near the subway station?
before.cn: C1: 太方便了。地铁站附近有商场吗？

after.en: That's convenient. Are there any shopping malls near the subway station?
after.cn: 太方便了。地铁站附近有商场吗？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Yes, there's a large shopping mall next to the station, you can buy everything you need there.
before.cn: C2: 有，旁边就有个大型商场，你需要的东西都能买到。

after.en: Yes, there's a large shopping mall next to the station, you can buy everything you need there.
after.cn: 有，旁边就有个大型商场，你需要的东西都能买到。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Thank you very much for your detailed guidance.
before.cn: C1: 非常感谢你详细的指引。

after.en: Thank you very much for your detailed guidance.
after.cn: 非常感谢你详细的指引。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: You're welcome! If you get lost, you can ask the local people, they're very friendly. Have a nice trip!
before.cn: C2: 不客气！迷路了可以问当地人，他们很友好。祝你出行顺利！

after.en: You're welcome! If you get lost, you can ask the local people, they're very friendly. Have a nice trip!
after.cn: 不客气！迷路了可以问当地人，他们很友好。祝你出行顺利！
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: How long have you been like this? Do you have any other symptoms, like nausea or sore throat?
before.cn: C1: 这样多久了？还有其他症状吗？比如恶心、喉咙痛？

after.en: How long have you been like this? Do you have any other symptoms, like nausea or sore throat?
after.cn: 这样多久了？还有其他症状吗？比如恶心、喉咙痛？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Two days. Sometimes I feel a little nauseous, but no sore throat. I've been working overtime these days, maybe I'm too tired.
before.cn: C2: 两天了，偶尔有点恶心，喉咙不痛。这几天加班多，可能太累了。

after.en: Two days. Sometimes I feel a little nauseous, but no sore throat. I've been working overtime these days, maybe I'm too tired.
after.cn: 两天了，偶尔有点恶心，喉咙不痛。这几天加班多，可能太累了。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Let me take your temperature and check your blood pressure. You have a slight fever and high blood pressure. You must have an injection first. Then, take some medicine on time.
before.cn: C1: 我给你量下体温、测下血压。有点低烧，血压偏高，先打一针，然后按时吃药。

after.en: I will take your temperature and blood pressure and seek medical advice. Treatment will depend on the medical assessment.
after.cn: 我会测量你的体温和血压，并寻求医疗建议。治疗应根据医疗评估决定。

before.en: C2: How to take the medicine? Are there any side effects?
before.cn: C2: 药怎么吃？有副作用吗？

after.en: How to take the medicine? Are there any side effects?
after.cn: 药怎么吃？有副作用吗？
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Three times a day, after meals, one pill each time. No obvious side effects, just don't drink alcohol while taking the medicine.
before.cn: C1: 一天三次，饭后吃，每次一片，没明显副作用，吃药期间别喝酒。

after.en: Follow the instructions for any prescribed medicine. Confirm the name, dose, frequency and possible side effects with the medical professional.
after.cn: 如有处方药，请遵照医嘱使用，并向医务人员确认药名、剂量、服用频次及可能的副作用。

before.en: C2: How soon can I get well? I need to go back to work soon.
before.cn: C2: 多久能好？我还要尽快回去工作。

after.en: How soon can I get well? I need to go back to work soon.
after.cn: 多久能好？我还要尽快回去工作。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Don't worry, it is not serious. You must have a good rest for at least two days, avoid staying up late and heavy work. You'll be well in two days.
before.cn: C1: 别担心，不严重。至少好好休息两天，别熬夜、别干重活，两天就能好。

after.en: Rest and avoid strenuous work until you have received medical advice about returning to duty.
after.cn: 先休息，避免繁重工作，并就何时恢复值班征求医疗意见。

before.en: C2: Thank you, doctor. I'll follow your advice.
before.cn: C2: 谢谢医生，我会听你的建议。

after.en: Thank you, doctor. I'll follow your advice.
after.cn: 谢谢医生，我会听你的建议。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: That's perfect. Do you also know where the nearest tourist attraction is? I want to take some photos after shopping.
before.cn: C1: 太好了。知道最近的景点在哪吗？购物后想去拍拍照。

after.en: That's perfect. Do you also know where the nearest tourist attraction is? I want to take some photos after shopping.
after.cn: 太好了。知道最近的景点在哪吗？购物后想去拍拍照。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Yes, the famous coastal landmark is just across the central park. The view from the top is breathtaking, especially the sunset.
before.cn: C2: 知道，著名的海岸地标就在中央公园对面，登顶景色绝美，日落尤其好看。

after.en: The coastal landmark is on the other side of the central park. The view from the top is excellent, especially at sunset.
after.cn: 海岸地标在中央公园另一侧，从上面看景色很好，尤其是日落时。

before.en: C1: Sounds exciting. How can I get there from the shopping mall?
before.cn: C1: 太心动了。从商场怎么过去？

after.en: Sounds exciting. How can I get there from the shopping mall?
after.cn: 太心动了。从商场怎么过去？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: You can take the subway, it's just two stops away. Or you can walk along the seaside, it takes about 20 minutes and the scenery is beautiful.
before.cn: C2: 坐地铁两站就到，也可以沿海边步行 20 分钟，沿途风景超美。

after.en: You can take the subway, it's just two stops away. Or you can walk along the seaside, it takes about 20 minutes and the scenery is beautiful.
after.cn: 坐地铁两站就到，也可以沿海边步行 20 分钟，沿途风景超美。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: I prefer walking. Are there any restaurants near the attraction? I want to try local food.
before.cn: C1: 我更喜欢步行。景点附近有餐厅吗？想尝尝当地美食。

after.en: I prefer walking. Are there any restaurants near the attraction? I want to try local food.
after.cn: 我更喜欢步行。景点附近有餐厅吗？想尝尝当地美食。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Yes, there are many seafood restaurants nearby, the food is fresh and delicious.
before.cn: C2: 有，附近很多海鲜餐厅，食材新鲜、味道正宗。

after.en: Yes, there are many seafood restaurants nearby, the food is fresh and delicious.
after.cn: 有，附近有很多海鲜餐厅，食材新鲜，味道可口。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Thank you so much for your help!
before.cn: C1: 太感谢你的帮忙了！

after.en: Thank you so much for your help!
after.cn: 太感谢你的帮忙了！
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: You're welcome! Enjoy your trip and have a good time!
before.cn: C2: 不客气！祝你旅途愉快，玩得开心！

after.en: You're welcome! Enjoy your trip and have a good time!
after.cn: 不客气！祝你旅途愉快，玩得开心！
after.speaker: C2

before.en: Here you are. I'm the chief engineer of MV Blue Whale. All documents are complete and valid.
before.cn: 给你。我是 "蓝鲸" 号轮机长，所有证件齐全且在有效期内。

after.en: Here you are. I am the Chief Engineer of M/V Blue Whale. The documents are complete and valid.
after.cn: 给您。我是Blue Whale轮的轮机长，证件齐全且有效。

before.en: C1: What's your last port of call and next destination? How long will you stay at this port?
before.cn: C1: 上一个停靠港和下一个目的港是哪里？在本港停留多久？

after.en: What's your last port of call and next destination? How long will you stay at this port?
after.cn: 上一个停靠港和下一个目的港是哪里？在本港停留多久？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Singapore. Our next destination is Rotterdam. We'll stay here for three days to load cargo and refuel.
before.cn: C2: 上港是新加坡，下港是鹿特丹。在此停留 3 天，装货、补充燃油。

after.en: Singapore. Our next destination is Rotterdam. We'll stay here for three days to load cargo and refuel.
after.cn: 上港是新加坡，下港是鹿特丹。在此停留 3 天，装货、补充燃油。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Any restricted items to declare, such as tobacco, alcohol or controlled goods?
before.cn: C1: 有烟草、酒类或管制物品等限制品需要申报吗？

after.en: Any restricted items to declare, such as tobacco, alcohol or controlled goods?
after.cn: 有烟草、酒类或管制物品等限制品需要申报吗？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Only crew personal effects, no restricted or contraband items. We've filled out the declaration form clearly.
before.cn: C2: 只有船员个人物品，无限制品和违禁品，申报表已如实填写。

after.en: Only crew personal effects. There are no restricted or prohibited items. We have completed the declaration accurately.
after.cn: 只有船员个人物品，没有限制品或违禁品。我们已如实填写申报表。

before.en: C1: Any fever, cough or other abnormal symptoms in past 48 hours? Have all crew members completed the health check?
before.cn: C1: 过去 48 小时内有发热、咳嗽等异常症状吗？所有船员都完成健康检查了吗？

after.en: Has anyone had fever, cough or other unusual symptoms in the past 48 hours? Have all crewmembers completed the health check?
after.cn: 过去48小时内，有人出现发热、咳嗽或其他异常症状吗？所有船员都完成健康检查了吗？

before.en: C2: No, all crew are healthy. Here's our health declaration and vaccination certificate.
before.cn: C2: 没有，全体船员身体健康。这是健康声明和疫苗接种证明。

after.en: No, all crew are healthy. Here's our health declaration and vaccination certificate.
after.cn: 没有，全体船员身体健康。这是健康声明和疫苗接种证明。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Okay, the inspection is passed. You can go through the formalities now.
before.cn: C1: 好的，查验通过，可办理后续手续。

after.en: The document check is complete. You may proceed with the remaining formalities.
after.cn: 证件查验已经完成，可以办理其余手续。

before.en: C2: Thank you very much.
before.cn: C2: 非常感谢。

after.en: Thank you very much.
after.cn: 非常感谢。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: Good evening. How is the weather and sea condition now? Any abnormal situations around the ship?
before.cn: 晚上好。当前天气和海况如何？船舶周围有无异常情况？

after.en: What are the present weather and sea conditions? Are there any unusual situations around the vessel?
after.cn: 目前天气和海况如何？本船周围有异常情况吗？

before.en: C1: Very good. Check the navigation lights and radar equipment regularly. Report immediately if there's any fault.
before.cn: C1: 很好。定期检查航行灯和雷达设备，如有故障立即上报。

after.en: Very good. Check the navigation lights and radar equipment regularly. Report immediately if there's any fault.
after.cn: 很好。定期检查航行灯和雷达设备，如有故障立即上报。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Yes, sir. The navigation lights are normal, radar is working stably. I'll check them every 30 minutes.
before.cn: C2: 收到，长官。航行灯正常，雷达运行稳定，我每 30 分钟检查一次。

after.en: Yes, sir. The navigation lights are normal, radar is working stably. I'll check them every 30 minutes.
after.cn: 收到，长官。航行灯正常，雷达运行稳定，我每 30 分钟检查一次。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Has the ship's course and speed changed recently? Keep an eye on the course deviation.
before.cn: C1: 船舶航向和航速近期有无变动？留意航向偏移情况。

after.en: Have the course or speed changed? Monitor any course deviation.
after.cn: 航向或航速有变化吗？注意监控航向偏差。

before.en: C2: No change, current course is 120°, speed is 15 knots. No obvious deviation found.
before.cn: C2: 无变动，当前航向 120 度，航速 15 节，未发现明显偏移。

after.en: No change, current course is 120°, speed is 15 knots. No obvious deviation found.
after.cn: 无变动，当前航向 120 度，航速 15 节，未发现明显偏移。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Alright. Keep a close watch and maintain communication. Wake me up if anything urgent happens.
before.cn: C1: 好的。加强瞭望，保持通讯畅通，有紧急情况立即叫醒我。

after.en: Alright. Keep a close watch and maintain communication. Wake me up if anything urgent happens.
after.cn: 好的。加强瞭望，保持通讯畅通，有紧急情况立即叫醒我。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Understood, sir. I'll stay alert all the time.
before.cn: C2: 明白，长官。我会全程保持警惕。

after.en: Understood, sir. I'll stay alert all the time.
after.cn: 明白，长官。我会全程保持警惕。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: Good morning. We'll start loading general cargo at 9 AM today. Have you prepared the loading plan and tools?
before.cn: 早上好。今日上午 9 点开始装卸杂货，装卸方案和工具准备好了吗？

after.en: Good morning. We'll start loading general cargo at 9 AM today. Have you prepared the loading plan and tools?
after.cn: 早上好。我们今天上午9点开始装载杂货。装货计划和工具准备好了吗？

before.en: Good morning, sir. The loading plan is ready, and all loading tools like cranes and slings have been inspected and are in good condition.
before.cn: 早上好，长官。装卸方案已备好，起重机、吊索等工具均已检查，状态良好。

after.en: The loading plan is ready. All cargo-handling equipment, including the cranes and slings, has been inspected and is in good condition.
after.cn: 装货计划已备妥。起重机、吊索等装卸设备均已检查，状态良好。

before.en: C1: Great. Pay attention to the loading sequence, heavy goods at the bottom and light goods on top. Avoid overloading each hold.
before.cn: C1: 很好。注意装卸顺序，重货在下、轻货在上，避免单个货舱超载。

after.en: Great. Pay attention to the loading sequence, heavy goods at the bottom and light goods on top. Avoid overloading each hold.
after.cn: 很好。注意装货顺序，重货在下、轻货在上，避免货舱超载。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Understood. We'll follow the plan strictly and check the weight of each batch of goods.
before.cn: C2: 明白。我们会严格按方案执行，核对每批货物重量。

after.en: Understood. We'll follow the plan strictly and check the weight of each batch of goods.
after.cn: 明白。我们会严格按方案执行，核对每批货物重量。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Also, secure the goods tightly after loading to prevent shifting during navigation. Report any damaged goods in time.
before.cn: C1: 另外，装货后加固货物，防止航行中移位，破损货物及时上报。

after.en: Also, secure the goods tightly after loading to prevent shifting during navigation. Report any damaged goods in time.
after.cn: 另外，装货后加固货物，防止航行中移位，破损货物及时上报。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Yes, sir. We'll use ropes and nets to fix the goods. Damaged goods will be marked and reported immediately.
before.cn: C2: 收到，长官。我们会用绳索、网具固定货物，破损货物立即标记上报。

after.en: Yes, sir. We'll use ropes and nets to fix the goods. Damaged goods will be marked and reported immediately.
after.cn: 收到，长官。我们会用绳索、网具固定货物，破损货物立即标记上报。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Alright. Cooperate with the crew closely and finish the loading work efficiently.
before.cn: C1: 好的。和船员密切配合，高效完成装卸工作。

after.en: Alright. Cooperate with the crew closely and finish the loading work efficiently.
after.cn: 好的。与船员密切配合，高效完成装货作业。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Will do, sir. We'll ensure the safety and quality of the loading operation.
before.cn: C2: 一定，长官。我们会保障装卸作业安全合规。

after.en: Will do, sir. We'll ensure the safety and quality of the loading operation.
after.cn: 是，先生。我们会确保装货作业的安全和质量。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: Captain, the latest forecast shows that there will be moderate rain and force 5-6 winds in the afternoon, with swells of 2-3 meters.
before.cn: 船长，最新预报显示今日下午有中雨，风力 5-6 级，浪高 2-3 米。

after.en: Captain, the latest forecast shows that there will be moderate rain and force 5-6 winds in the afternoon, with swells of 2-3 meters.
after.cn: 船长，最新预报显示下午有中雨，风力5—6级，涌浪高2—3米。

before.en: C1: Not good. Will the weather get worse in the evening? Any storm warnings?
before.cn: C1: 情况不佳。晚间天气会恶化吗？有风暴预警吗？

after.en: Not good. Will the weather get worse in the evening? Any storm warnings?
after.cn: 情况不佳。晚间天气会恶化吗？有风暴预警吗？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: No storm warnings, but the wind will increase to force 7 at night, and visibility will decrease to 3 nautical miles.
before.cn: C2: 无风暴预警，但夜间风力增至 7 级，能见度降至 3 海里。

after.en: No storm warnings, but the wind will increase to force 7 at night, and visibility will decrease to 3 nautical miles.
after.cn: 无风暴预警，但夜间风力增至 7 级，能见度降至 3 海里。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Understood. Adjust the ship's speed appropriately, reduce to 12 knots to avoid rough sea impact.
before.cn: C1: 明白。适当调整航速，降至 12 节，规避大浪冲击。

after.en: Understood. Adjust the ship's speed appropriately, reduce to 12 knots to avoid rough sea impact.
after.cn: 明白。适当调整航速，降至 12 节，规避大浪冲击。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Yes, Captain. I'll update the weather information every hour and inform you of any changes.
before.cn: C2: 收到，船长。我每小时更新天气信息，有变动及时告知您。

after.en: Yes, Captain. I'll update the weather information every hour and inform you of any changes.
after.cn: 收到，船长。我每小时更新天气信息，有变动及时告知您。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Good. Remind all crew members to fasten loose items on deck and pay attention to safety during work.
before.cn: C1: 好的。提醒全体船员固定甲板松散物品，作业时注意安全。

after.en: Good. Remind all crew members to fasten loose items on deck and pay attention to safety during work.
after.cn: 好的。提醒全体船员固定甲板松散物品，作业时注意安全。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Will do. I'll post the weather notice on the bulletin board immediately.
before.cn: C2: 遵命。我立刻将天气通知张贴在公告栏。

after.en: Will do. I'll post the weather notice on the bulletin board immediately.
after.cn: 遵命。我立刻将天气通知张贴在公告栏。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: BOSUN, the deck crane can't work normally. It makes strange noise when starting, and the lifting power is insufficient.
before.cn: 水手长，甲板起重机无法正常工作，启动时有异响，起吊力不足。

after.en: Bosun, the deck crane is not operating normally. It makes an unusual noise on starting and cannot develop the expected lifting power.
after.cn: 水手长，甲板起重机工作异常，启动时有异响，起吊能力不足。

before.en: C1: It started 10 minutes ago. I checked the power supply, it's normal. The control switch has no obvious damage.
before.cn: C1: 10 分钟前出现的，电源正常，控制开关无明显损坏。

after.en: The problem started 10 minutes ago. The power supply is normal and the control switch has no visible damage.
after.cn: 故障始于10分钟前。电源正常，控制开关没有可见损坏。

before.en: C2: Okay, stop using the crane immediately to avoid further damage. I'll inform the chief officer and arrange the engineer to check it.
before.cn: C2: 好的，立即停用起重机，避免故障扩大。我上报大副，安排轮机员检修。

after.en: Stop using the crane. I will inform the Chief Officer and arrange for an engineer to inspect it.
after.cn: 停止使用起重机。我会报告大副，并安排轮机员检查。

before.en: C1: Yes. Should I clean the surrounding area of the crane and set up warning signs?
before.cn: C1: 收到。需要清理起重机周边区域、设置警示标识吗？

after.en: Yes. Should I clean the surrounding area of the crane and set up warning signs?
after.cn: 收到。需要清理起重机周边区域、设置警示标识吗？
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Yes, do that right now. Don't let any crew approach the faulty equipment.
before.cn: C2: 是的，立刻执行，禁止船员靠近故障设备。

after.en: Yes, do that right now. Don't let any crew approach the faulty equipment.
after.cn: 是的，立刻执行，禁止船员靠近故障设备。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Understood. I'll finish it at once and wait for the engineer's inspection.
before.cn: C1: 明白，我马上处理，等候轮机员检修。

after.en: Understood. I'll finish it at once and wait for the engineer's inspection.
after.cn: 明白，我马上处理，等候轮机员检修。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: Yes, Captain. Mooring lines are ready to be released, anchors are cleared, and all deck equipment is secured.
before.cn: 完成了，船长。系泊缆绳已做好解缆准备，锚已清理妥当，甲板设备全部固定完毕。

after.en: Yes, Captain. The mooring parties are ready for letting go. The anchors are ready for use, and all loose deck equipment has been secured.
after.cn: 是的，船长。解缆人员已经就位，锚已备妥，甲板上的活动设备已固定。

before.en: C1: Good. Check the communication system with the port and confirm the departure time again.
before.cn: C1: 很好。检查与港口的通讯系统，再次确认离港时间。

after.en: Good. Check the communication system with the port and confirm the departure time again.
after.cn: 很好。检查与港口的通讯系统，再次确认离港时间。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Checked, the communication system is normal. The port confirms we can depart at the scheduled time.
before.cn: C2: 已检查，通讯正常，港口确认可按时离港。

after.en: Checked, the communication system is normal. The port confirms we can depart at the scheduled time.
after.cn: 已检查，通讯正常，港口确认可按时离港。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Inform the engine room to stand by the main engine and adjust the power according to the departure instructions.
before.cn: C1: 通知机舱主机备车，按离港指令调整动力。

after.en: Inform the engine room to stand by the main engine and adjust the power according to the departure instructions.
after.cn: 通知机舱主机备车，按离港指令调整动力。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Understood. I've sent the notice to the engine room, and they are ready.
before.cn: C2: 明白，已通知机舱，他们已准备就绪。

after.en: Understood. I've sent the notice to the engine room, and they are ready.
after.cn: 明白，已通知机舱，他们已准备就绪。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: C1: Also, arrange crew to stand by at key positions and report the situation at any time.
before.cn: C1: 另外，安排船员在关键岗位待命，随时汇报情况。

after.en: Also, arrange crew to stand by at key positions and report the situation at any time.
after.cn: 另外，安排船员在关键岗位待命，随时汇报情况。
after.speaker: C1

before.en: C2: Will do. All crew are in place and waiting for your order.
before.cn: C2: 遵命，全体船员已就位，等候您的指令。

after.en: Will do. All crew are in place and waiting for your order.
after.cn: 遵命，全体船员已就位，等候您的指令。
after.speaker: C2

before.en: Roger. I'll rig the pilot ladder on our starboard side, one meter above the waterline. Over.
before.cn: 收到。我把引航员的梯子放在右舷，在水线之上一米。结束。

after.en: Roger. I will rig the pilot ladder on the starboard side, with the lower end one metre above the water. Over.
after.cn: 收到。我会在右舷装设引航梯，下端距水面一米。完毕，请回答。

before.en: Back to 16.
before.cn: 回到16。

after.en: Change back to VHF channel 16.
after.cn: 转回VHF 16频道。

before.en: (By transceiver) Second Officer, the Pilot wants us to deploy the pilot ladder on the starboard side, one meter above the water.
before.cn: (对讲机)二副:引水要我们把引水梯放在右舷，水面一米。

after.en: Second Officer, the pilot requests the pilot ladder on the starboard side, with the lower end one metre above the water.
after.cn: 二副，引航员要求在右舷装设引航梯，下端距水面一米。

before.en: Pilot ladder on the starboard, one meter above the water.
before.cn: 引航员梯在右舷，离水面一米。

after.en: Pilot ladder on the starboard side, lower end one metre above the water.
after.cn: 引航梯装在右舷，下端距水面一米。

before.en: Second Mate, will you tell Mike to wear a safety vest when he prepares the ladder?
before.cn: 二副，你能告诉麦克准备梯子的时候穿上安全背心吗？

after.en: Second Officer, tell Mike to wear the required personal protective equipment when rigging the ladder.
after.cn: 二副，请提醒迈克装设引航梯时穿戴规定的个人防护用品。

before.en: The Pilot will come aboard at around 09:20 as planned.
before.cn: 引水将按计划于09:20左右登船。

after.en: The Pilot will come aboard at around 09:20 as planned.
after.cn: 引航员将按计划于09:20左右登船。

before.en: Good morning, Pilot. The engine is now at half, and our course is North.
before.cn: 早上好，引水。主机现在是前进二，我们的航向是000。

after.en: Good morning, Pilot. The engine is at half ahead, and our course is 000 degrees.
after.cn: 早上好，引航员。主机半速前进，航向000度。

before.en: OK. Bring the engines to full ahead and change our course to 002, please.
before.cn: 好的。请把主机开到前进三，航向002。

after.en: Increase to full ahead and alter course to 002 degrees.
after.cn: 主机调至全速前进，转向002度。

before.en: Captain, there's an escort boat about 500 meters ahead.
before.cn: 船长，前方500米处有一艘护卫舰。

after.en: Captain, there's an escort boat about 500 meters ahead.
after.cn: 船长，前方约500米处有一艘护航艇。

before.en: We can do about 11.8 knots maximum, since we are half laden.
before.cn: 我们最多能做到11.8节，因为我们只装了一半。

after.en: We can do about 11.8 knots maximum, since we are half laden.
after.cn: 本船半载时最高航速约为11.8节。

before.en: Yes, they are. Captain, will you hoist the First Substitute Flag and Flag S before we reach that buoy?
before.cn: 是的，他们是。船长，在我们到达那个浮标之前，请你升起代一旗和S旗好吗？

after.en: Before we reach that buoy, hoist the signal flags specified in the agreed berthing instructions.
after.cn: 到达那个浮标前，按已确认的靠泊指示升挂规定的信号旗。

before.en: Yes. We'll berth on the starboard alongside the West Berth.
before.cn: 是的。我们将右舷靠泊西泊位。

after.en: We will berth starboard side alongside at the West Berth.
after.cn: 本船将在西泊位右舷靠泊。

before.en: engine is now at half: engine speed is set to full ahead: fastest engine speed
before.cn: 主机现在是进二，主机请加速到进三：最快速

after.en: Half ahead means half speed ahead; full ahead means full manoeuvring speed ahead.
after.cn: 半速前进表示前进半速挡，全速前进表示前进操纵全速挡。

before.en: Note: The engine speed varies from 'dead slow ahead', 'slow ahead', 'half ahead' to 'full ahead'
before.cn: 注意：主机转速从"微进一"、"进一"、"进二"到"进三"

after.en: The engine order settings are dead slow ahead, slow ahead, half ahead and full ahead.
after.cn: 前进车钟挡位为微速前进、慢速前进、半速前进和全速前进。

before.en: Stand by for walk back, sir.
before.cn: 准备松，长官。

after.en: Stand by to pay out the line under power.
after.cn: 准备使用缆机动力松缆。

before.en: OK. Walk back slowly.
before.cn: 好的。慢慢松。

after.en: OK. pay out slowly.
after.cn: 好的。慢慢松。

before.en: Bosun, should the end be in this position?

before.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。完车。

after.en: Engine room, this is bridge. Finished with engines.
after.cn: 机舱，这里是驾驶台。完车。

before.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Finished with engine, understood.
before.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。完车，收到。

after.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Finished with engines, understood.
after.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。完车，收到。

before.en: Please standby, I am testing the alarm system.
before.cn: 请稍候，我正在测试报警系统。

after.en: Please stand by. I am testing the alarm system.
after.cn: 请稍候。我正在测试报警系统。

before.en: Yes, I have. The synopsis shows a deep depression centered at 45°N 160°E, moving eastward at 25 knots.
before.cn: 收到了。天气形势显示一个加深的低压中心位于北纬45度东经160度，向东移动，速度25节。

after.en: The synopsis shows a deep depression centred at 45°N 160°E, moving east at 25 knots.
after.cn: 天气形势显示一个深低压中心位于北纬45度、东经160度，正以25节向东移动。

before.en: Keep monitoring the weather fax and update me if anything changes.
before.cn: 继续守听气象传真，有变化立即报告我。

after.en: Keep monitoring the weather fax and update me if anything changes.
after.cn: 继续接收并查看气象传真图，有变化及时报告。

before.en: We are in the dangerous semicircle. Let's alter course to port to increase our distance and find more sea room.
before.cn: 我们现在处于危险半圆。建议向左转向，增大距离，找到更多操纵余地。

after.en: The storm may create dangerous conditions along our route. Assess our position, sea room and the forecast before deciding on an alteration.
after.cn: 风暴可能使计划航线出现危险海况。决定改向前，先评估本船位置、海上余地及预报。

before.en: Shall I switch on the radar and post a lookout forward?
before.cn: 需要开启雷达并安排瞭头吗？

after.en: Shall we verify both radars and post an additional lookout forward?
after.cn: 是否检查确认两部雷达的状态，并在船首增派瞭望人员？

before.en: Yes. Use both radars, switch to narrow band, and keep a sharp lookout. Also reduce to safe speed.
before.cn: 是的。两部雷达都开启，用窄量程，保持正规瞭望。同时减速至安全航速。

after.en: Use both radars at appropriate range scales, maintain a proper lookout and proceed at a safe speed.
after.cn: 两部雷达采用适当量程，保持正规瞭望，并以安全航速航行。

before.en: Check the barometer too. A steady reading suggests this fog may persist for several hours.
before.cn: 检查一下气压计。如果气压稳定，这场雾可能会持续几个小时。

after.en: Check the barometer and the latest forecast. Do not infer how long the fog will last from pressure alone.
after.cn: 查看气压计和最新预报，不要只根据气压推断雾会持续多久。

before.en: It's time for the 0800 weather observation. Let's go to the bridge wing.
before.cn: 到0800时气象观测时间了。我们去驾驶台翼桥。

after.en: It's time for the 0800 weather observation. Let's go to the bridge wing.
after.cn: 到0800时气象观测时间了，我们去驾驶台翼部。

before.en: Wind is from 230 degrees at 22 knots, gusting 28. Cloud cover is 7 oktas, mainly Cumulus and Stratocumulus.
before.cn: 风向230度，风速22节，阵风28节。云量7八分，主要是积云和层积云。

after.en: Wind is from 230 degrees at 22 knots, gusting 28. Cloud cover is 7 oktas, mainly Cumulus and Stratocumulus.
after.cn: 风从230度方向吹来，风速22节，阵风28节。云量7/8，主要为积云和层积云。

before.en: Let's plan to stay north of 45°N to avoid the worst conditions. Plot a revised course accordingly.
before.cn: 我们计划保持在北纬45度以北航行，避开最恶劣海域。据此画出修改航线。

after.en: Compare the forecast conditions along the available routes and prepare a revised passage plan for review.
after.cn: 比较各可选航线的预报海况，编制修订航次计划供审核。

before.en: The wind rose shows prevailing northwesterly winds in this area. We'll have following seas for better fuel efficiency.
before.cn: 风玫瑰图显示该海域盛行西北风。顺浪航行可以提高燃油效率。

after.en: The wind rose indicates prevailing northwesterly winds. Assess the relative wind and waves for each proposed course.
after.cn: 风玫瑰图显示盛行西北风，应评估各拟定航向上的相对风浪。

before.cn: 船舶：港口交管，港口交管，这里是蓝海轮，VHF 16频道呼叫。能听到吗？

after.en: Harbor VTS, Harbor VTS, this is Blue Ocean on VHF channel 16. How do you read me?
after.cn: 港口交管，港口交管，这里是Blue Ocean轮，在VHF 16频道呼叫。收听情况如何？

before.cn: 交管：蓝海轮，这里是港口交管。声音清楚。

after.en: Blue Ocean, this is Harbor VTS. I read you loud and clear.
after.cn: Blue Ocean轮，这里是港口交管。收听清晰。

before.cn: 交管：请切换到12频道并守听。

after.cn: 呼号ABCD。船位在3号浮标以东2海里，航向085度，航速10节。

before.cn: 交管：请在12频道和16频道保持守听。

after.en: Keep listening watch on channel one-two and channel one-six.
after.cn: 请在12频道和16频道保持守听。

after.en: Harbor VTS, this is Blue Ocean entering the traffic separation scheme.
after.cn: 港口交管，这里是Blue Ocean轮，正进入分道通航制水域。

after.en: Report your last port, next port and ETA to the pilot station.
after.cn: 请报告上一港、下一港和到引航站的预计时间。

before.en: Ship: Last port Singapore, next port Ningbo. ETA pilot station one-four-zero-zero local time.
before.cn: 船舶：上一港新加坡，下一港宁波。预计当地时间14点到引航站。

before.cn: 交管：减速到8节，靠航道右侧航行。

after.en: Report any change of course or engine status immediately.

before.en: PSCO: Chief Engineer, please show me the engine room logbook and oil record book.
before.cn: 检查官：轮机长，请出示机舱日志和油类记录簿。

before.cn: 轮机长：这是记录簿，每天更新，并由值班轮机员签字。

after.en: The engine-room logbook is up to date. The Oil Record Book has been completed and signed in accordance with the applicable requirements.
after.cn: 机舱日志已及时填写。《油类记录簿》已按适用要求填写并签署。

before.cn: 检查官：油水分离器工作正常吗？

after.en: Is the oily water separator operational?
after.cn: 油水分离器工作正常吗？
after.speaker: PSCO

before.cn: 轮机长：正常。今天早上测试过，15ppm报警工作正常。

after.en: Yes. It was tested this morning, and the fifteen ppm alarm worked normally.
after.cn: 正常。今天早上测试过，15ppm报警工作正常。
after.speaker: Chief Engineer

before.en: PSCO: Show me the emergency generator test record.
before.cn: 检查官：请给我看应急发电机测试记录。

after.en: Show me the emergency generator test record.
after.cn: 请给我看应急发电机测试记录。
after.speaker: PSCO

after.cn: 应急发电机上周进行了带负荷测试。

before.cn: 检查官：我在分油机附近发现漏油，请在开航前整改。

before.cn: 检查官：设备现在工作状态良好。
